stepIntro: Everything below this is on step {n}.
stepTitleHint: Shown above the step. Set the first step's title in Form settings.
stepDescriptionHint: A short line under the step title.
title: Title
numberBadgeHint: A round “1”, “2”… next to the title.
helpIconTextHint: Adds a “?” next to the title that shows this text.
collapsibleHint: People can click the title to fold the section.
sectionTip: Add a “Disable” rule to grey out this section until earlier questions are answered.
tabsHint: Drag questions onto a tab in the form to move them there.
dialogIntro: A pop-up that opens from a button with “Open a dialog”. Answers are kept only when people confirm.
dialogActionsIntro: What happens when people confirm. Use {draft:key} to reuse what they typed.
textHint: You can use bold and links.
calloutTip: Add a rule to show this message only when it's needed.
signatureSaved: The signature is saved as an image with the answers.
presetsIntro: The “Add” button offers these choices. Each one can pre-fill the new item, like a room type and its checklist.
presetJsonHint: Answers as JSON, like {"type": "kitchen"}. Use lists for groups inside the item.
layoutTableHint: Each item is a table row made from its first row of questions. The rest shows below it.
layoutGridHint: Small cards in a grid. Click one to open it.
layoutCardsHint: Each item is a card with its own title and questions.
itemTitleHint: Use {n} for the number or {key} for an answer, like “Guest {n}” or “{name}”.
itemSummaryHint: A short grey line. {count:key} counts the items in a group inside. {count:key|None|1 item|# items} picks wording by count.
doneFieldHint: Pick a switch or checkbox, like “This room is finished”. It shows as a Done button or chip.
openPageHint: The item opens on its own page with a Back link. Good for items with tabs.
openModalHint: The item opens in a pop-up form.
openInlineHint: The questions show inside the card.
addModalHint: A pop-up asks for the item’s details first.
addInlineHint: A blank item is added right away.
dialogAsksMarkedHint: Only questions marked “Only in the item’s dialog”, like type and name.
typePickerLabelHint: The dialog starts with a list of your “Add choices”, like room types.
offerOtherHint: Lets people skip the choices and fill in everything themselves.
uniqueNamesHint: A second “Bathroom” becomes “Bathroom 2”. Pick the field that holds the name.
editTitleHint: Leave empty to use the item’s title.
itemMenuOffHint: Cards only show a bin icon.
dragToReorderHint: People can drag small cards to reorder them.
limitsHint: The form starts with the minimum and can't be sent with fewer.
itemsCollapsibleHint: Click an item's title to fold it.
action_setAll: Set an answer on all items in a group
action_add: Add an item to a group
action_emit: Send an event to your page
jsonValuesHint: Answers to fill in, as JSON. Use {key} for an answer in this item and {draft:key} for one typed in a dialog.
nextHint: Stops if something on this step is missing.
setAllValuesHint: Values: {values}. In a dialog, use {draft:key} for what was picked there.
submitHint: Checks all answers and sends the form.
noActions: Nothing happens yet. Add an action.
buttonTextHint: {next} shows the next step's title. {value:key} shows an answer.
buttonActionsIntro: What happens on click. Actions run in order and stop if one can't finish, like a step with errors.
stepNextHint: Leave empty to use the form’s default. {next} is the next step's title.
stepHideBackHint: On this step, people can only go forward.
